title: ASTROSSC-290 duplicate signer threshold bypass
summary: reset_signers accepts duplicate PKs; one private key compromise satisfies multi-sig threshold. Triager confirmed technically valid; closed Informative citing 'reset_signers protected by OwnerCap; signer management performed by protocol team through controlled processes — trusted role misconfiguration outside threat model'.
key_lesson: Trusted-role-misconfiguration class always closes Informative on HackenProof regardless of (a) Gnosis Safe precedent, (b) AVA-1 distinction, (c) bombshell evidence (project's own commented-out test). Triagers anchor on threat model, not technical merit.
